chain.title: Palette Swap in the Citadel
chain.desc: Ender Golems patrol the Ruined Citadel and drop a Void Core on death.

chain.title: A Splinter of the Void
chain.desc: The Void Core is the Ender Golem's only drop and can be right-clicked to summon Void Runes.

chain.title: The Nether's Broken Warmachine
chain.desc: The Netherite Monstrosity is summoned in the Soul Blacksmith and is the mod's entry-tier boss.

chain.title: Torn From the Colossus
chain.desc: The Monstrous Horn drops from the Netherite Monstrosity alongside the Infernal Forge.

chain.title: Wearing the Beast's Skull
chain.desc: Smithing a Monstrous Horn onto a netherite helmet knocks nearby entities back when you fall below half health.

chain.title: The Hammer That Was a Pickaxe
chain.desc: The Infernal Forge is a Netherite Monstrosity drop that deals area damage on right-click and still mines like a pickaxe.

chain.title: Out-of-Place Machinery
chain.desc: The Harbinger sleeps in the Ancient Factory and fights with laser beams and a flight phase.

chain.title: Salvage From the Factory Floor
chain.desc: The Harbinger drops a Witherite Block, which unpacks into nine Witherite Ingots.

chain.title: Shoulder-Mounted Artillery
chain.desc: Built from Witherite, gunpowder and a redstone block, it fires Wither Missiles and sneak-fires Wither Howitzers.

chain.title: Wasn't That a Shulker?
chain.desc: The Ender Guardian seals the Ruined Citadel and answers gravity-pull grabs with a brutal second phase.

chain.title: The Hand That Pulls
chain.desc: The Gauntlet of Guard is the Ender Guardian's signature drop and yanks entities toward you on right-click.

chain.title: Reforged in Nothing
chain.desc: Fusing a Void Core into the Infernal Forge produces a pickaxe that fires Void Runes in a fan.

chain.title: Howitzers of the End
chain.desc: Fusing a Void Core into the Wither Assault Shoulder Weapon upgrades its payload to Void Howitzers.

chain.title: Death Finds a Way
chain.desc: Digging the suspicious sand inside the Cursed Pyramid wakes the Ancient Remnant.

chain.title: Bottled Desert Fury
chain.desc: The Ancient Remnant drops this bottle, which summons two orbiting sandstorms around you.

chain.title: Vortex in the Fist
chain.desc: Fusing Sandstorm in a Bottle into the Gauntlet of Guard lets it summon a Void Vortex.

chain.title: The Extinguished Fire
chain.desc: Ignis must be summoned in the Burning Arena and is widely rated the mod's hardest fight.

chain.title: Metal From a Dead Sun
chain.desc: Ignitium Ingots drop only from Ignis and upgrade netherite armour through a smithing template.

chain.title: Wings of the Burning Arena
chain.desc: Fusing an Elytra into an Ignitium Chestplate merges flight and fire-tier armour into one slot.

chain.title: A Multidimensional Predator
chain.desc: The Leviathan is summoned in the Sunken City and is invincible outside of water.

chain.title: Grapple of the Deep
chain.desc: The Leviathan's drop fires a grappling hook on right-click and a damaging tentacle on left-click.

chain.title: Crusade Against the Curse
chain.desc: Maledictus is summoned at the Cursed Tombstone inside the Frosted Prison.

chain.title: Armour That Refuses the Blow
chain.desc: Cursium armour is smithed from Maledictus' ingots and can outright ignore incoming attacks.

chain.title: The Calm After the Storm
chain.desc: Scylla the Storm Empress rules the sky-borne Acropolis and completes the Cataclysmfarer gauntlet.

notes: Verified against L_Enders_Cataclysm-3.31.jar: 282 ids appear both as assets/cataclysm/models/item/*.json and as item./block. lang keys. Boss roster confirmed from data/cataclysm/advancements/kill_all_bosses.json, which requires netherite_monstrosity, ender_guardian, the_harbinger, ancient_remnant, ignis, the_leviathan, maledictus and scylla - all eight exist in this jar and all are used. Every drop claim is taken from data/cataclysm/loot_tables/entities/*.json and every fusion claim from data/cataclysm/recipes/weapon_infusion/*.json. Ordering follows the advancement parent tree (find_<structure> -> kill_<boss>) plus community difficulty guides: Netherite Monstrosity is documented as the first boss, Ignis and Scylla as the last. IDS DROPPED: cataclysm:cursium_upgrade_smithing_template (referenced by the cursium smithing recipes but has no assets/cataclysm/models/item entry in this jar, so it fails the set-membership check); cataclysm:barako and cataclysm:the_cataclysmfarer as entities (no entity.cataclysm.* lang key - 'the_cataclysmfarer' exists only as a music disc). No boss listed in the task brief was missing: all seven named bosses plus Scylla are present.
